card.title: Acknowledge the Disrespect
card.instruction: Make someone apologize for the disrespect to your position, not merely for what happened.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your apology should mention interrupting the chair, not just spilling the tea.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: 'Chair.' Let's repair the title while we're here.

mechanism: A insists that an apology repair disrespect to the chair's office rather than damage or personal interruption.
confusable: Unlike seeking an ordinary apology, A must keep redirecting remorse toward rank or title.
comparison: D51-a corrects the noun in an apology; D51-b insists a trainer's authority be restored publicly before the next drill.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
